title: QatarEnergy announces/resumes LNG production in Qatar by April 30?
description:
QatarEnergy, a Qatari state-owned petroleum company, announced on March 2 that it would halt production of liquefied natural gas (LNG) due to military strikes on its operating facilities (see: https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/MediaCenter/Pages/newsdetails.aspx?ItemId=3892).

This market will resolve to “Yes” if QatarEnergy resumes production of liquefied natural gas at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar, or officially announces that such production has resumed or will resume, by April 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

QatarEnergy resuming the production of other halted products, including downstream LNG-related products, or resuming transportation of LNG without resuming production, will not alone count.

An official announcement that LNG production will resume at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar must signal the end of the total LNG production halt effective immediately or on a specific date or clearly defined time window. Mere statements that production will resume at some undefined point in the future, or that production will resume once the halt has ended, will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from QatarEnergy (https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/Pages/vHome.aspx); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Following the fragile ceasefire amid U.S.-Iran tensions, QatarEnergy began mobilizing engineers and workers in early April 2026 to restart LNG production at its Ras Laffan facilities after a March halt triggered by missile strikes and force majeure declarations, damaging key trains and blocking Strait of Hormuz exports. Credible reports from Reuters indicated partial resumption with two of three trains at QatarEnergy LNG's North 1 operational by April 8, meeting market criteria for announcement or resumption by April 30. Trader consensus at 100% Yes reflects this skin-in-the-game assessment, though full capacity ramp-up could take months amid repair needs. Rare oracle disputes over "resumption" definitions or late confirmations remain possible shifts.

Orlando Magic face a major setback with star forward Franz Wagner ruled out for a third straight game due to a right calf strain from Game 4, thinning their wing scoring and spacing around Paolo Banchero. Pistons' Tobias Harris and Kevin Huerter navigated questionable tags recently, adding depth, while Orlando's elite defense must overcome momentum shift and travel fatigue in this elimination clash.

San Antonio Spurs at 20.3% reflect their 62-20 regular season and first playoff series win since 2017 via a 4-1 ouster of Portland, positioning Victor Wembanyama for a potential West finals clash with OKC. In the East, New York Knicks (8.6%) advanced past Atlanta 4-2 to face Philadelphia (2.9%) in semis after the 76ers' Game 7 upset of Boston, while No. 1 seed Detroit Pistons (5.4%) trail Orlando 3-3 in a shaky first-round series, heightening East volatility amid widespread playoff injuries.

eventMetadata.context_description: Gavin Newsom leads Polymarket trader consensus at 27% implied probability for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, outpacing Kamala Harris at 10% despite her edge in recent national polls averaging 29% from April surveys by Harvard CAPS/Harris, Echelon Insights, and McLaughlin & Associates. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez at 8% draws progressive youth support, while Jon Ossoff's 7% reflects Georgia Senate momentum. In this wide-open primary absent an incumbent, consolidation hinges on 2026 midterm results, early-state polling in Iowa and New Hampshire, and endorsements from party elders.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket reflects a tightly contested early race for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, with HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. holding a slim 49% edge over Vice President J.D. Vance at 39.1% and Secretary of State Marco Rubio at 21.3%, driven by post-Trump succession jockeying amid the president's second term. RFK Jr.'s lead stems from his April 4 midterm travel push to expand the MAHA coalition and family endorsements signaling a 2028 bid, boosting his outsider appeal on health policy reforms. Rubio has gained via a strong 35% CPAC straw poll finish in late March and White House insider support for his foreign policy role and MAGA alignment, challenging Vance's VP incumbency advantage. The 2026 midterms, Trump endorsements, and policy wins could widen gaps in this fluid primary field.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 28 - May 5, 2026?
description:
